'''Rancor-dragons''' were mutated [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] with wings, created through [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]] at [[Anil Kesh]]. Rancor-dragons could fly. [[Butch]] was a rancor-dragon. They were slightly smaller than true rancors, and were used as mounts by the [[Je'daii]].
